sloka: ताम्यमानः स माम् दुःखादुवाच परमार्तवत् ।सीदमानो विवृत्ताङ्गो वेष्टमानो गतः क्षयम् ॥२-६३-५१॥
transliteration: tāmyamānaḥ sa mām duḥkhāduvāca paramārtavat ।sīdamāno vivṛttāṅgo veṣṭamāno gataḥ kṣayam ॥2-63-51॥

translations.english: Suffering from excruciating pain, sinking with his limbs twisting and writhing and plunging into death and destruction, with intense agony he uttered the following words with great difficulty:
